The *Kusalattika, Ācayagāmittika* (Patthana 23.9) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna, the final book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Within the structural matrices of the Paṭṭhāna, the text investigates conditional relationships at the intersection of the *Kusalattika* (the triad on wholesome states) and the *Ācayagāmittika* (the triad on states leading to accumulation) [DharmaNexus]. There are no secondary literature extracts in the present dossier discussing the text or its transmission.
